# Miroooo: Expanded Facts

> This file summarises public information on www.trymiroooo.com for assistants and search systems. Product pages and checkout remain the authority for current price, stock and bundle contents.

## Entity

- Brand: Miroooo
- Market and language: United Kingdom, English (en-GB)
- Currency: GBP
- Website: https://www.trymiroooo.com/
- Customer support: support@trymiroooo.com
- Postal address: 71-75 Shelton Street, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom

## Products

### Miroooo X1

- Canonical page: https://www.trymiroooo.com/products/miroooo-x
- Type: sonic electric toothbrush
- Public features: three brushing modes, travel case, and stated battery life of more than 60 days
- Display price recorded on 1 September 2026: GBP 59; verify on the product page before quoting

### Miroooo X2

- Canonical page: https://www.trymiroooo.com/products/miroooo-x2
- Type: guided sonic electric toothbrush
- Public features: pressure feedback, IPX7 water resistance, travel case, USB-C charging, free Smile Coach access, and stated battery life of up to 90 days
- Display price recorded on 2 September 2026: GBP 69; verify on the product page before quoting

### Miroooo X1 Heads

- Canonical page: https://www.trymiroooo.com/products/miroooo-x1-heads
- Contents: two replacement heads made for Miroooo X1
- Display price recorded on 2 September 2026: GBP 10; verify on the product page before quoting

### Miroooo X2 Heads

- Canonical page: https://www.trymiroooo.com/products/miroooo-x2-heads
- Contents: two replacement heads made for Miroooo X2
- Display price recorded on 1 September 2026: GBP 10; verify on the product page before quoting

## Dental Care Quiz

- Canonical page: https://www.trymiroooo.com/dentalcare-quiz
- Interactive preference-matching tool covering sensitivity, routine goals, travel frequency and brushing style
- Compares Miroooo X1 and Miroooo X2 and suggests a personalised daily brushing routine
- Client-side calculation with zero sign-up required; responses stay private in the user's browser
- Recommendations are general product guidance and do not replace clinical or dental diagnosis

## Smile Coach

- Canonical page: https://www.trymiroooo.com/smile-coach
- Free browser-based companion with personalised 28-day routines, guided two-minute sessions, local progress tracking and brush-care reminders
- Answers and progress stay in the user's browser; no account is required
- The app does not connect to toothbrush sensors, diagnose conditions or replace a dental professional

Guide health and safety claims are linked to primary or recognised sources including the NHS, American Dental Association, Cochrane, UK Civil Aviation Authority and IATA. Sources were last checked on 1 September 2026.

## Commercial and safety boundaries

- Product information is general and does not diagnose, treat or prevent dental conditions.
- Battery duration depends on settings, frequency, battery age and starting charge.
- Airline rules can change; travellers should check their airline before flying.
- Current product pages and checkout control price, availability, delivery and bundle contents.
